# What a page is handed

The `Bridge` interface `connect()` resolves to: the launch params, the settings, the host, the service, and the methods that act on them.

Read from the source: every name below, its signature, its JSDoc, and — for a type or a class — its own members.

| Name | Kind | Defined in | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`Bridge`](#bridge) | interface | `contract.ts` | What an extension's page is handed. |

## Bridge

```typescript
interface Bridge<P extends LaunchParams = LaunchParams, S extends ExtensionSettings = ExtensionSettings,>
```

What an extension's page is handed.

**Also** [`LaunchParams`](/docs/sdk/extension-bridge/reference-the-wire#launchparams), [`ExtensionSettings`](/docs/sdk/extension-bridge/reference-the-wire#extensionsettings).

| Member | Kind | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `extensionId` | field | `string` | The id this frame is, as the host named it. |
| `params` | field | `P` | Launch parameters, as the host passed them. |
| `settings` | field | `S` | What `contributes.settings` is configured to. |
| `theme` | field | `string` | The host's theme now. Use `onTheme` to follow it. |
| `tokens` | field | `ThemeTokens` | The published design tokens, already applied to this document's root. Here as a reading for anything that needs a value rather than a CSS variable — a canvas, a chart library. |
| `rpc` | method | `(method: string, args?: RpcArgs, timeoutMs?: number,) => Promise<T>` | Call a backend RPC. Rejects with the host's refusal, as a sentence. |
| `navigate` | method | `(to: string) => void` | Ask the host app to navigate. It decides whether to. |
| `close` | method | `() => void` | Tell the host this surface is finished. |
| `onTheme` | method | `(fn: (theme: string) => void) => () => void` | Follow the host's theme. Returns an unsubscribe. |
| `onParams` | method | `(fn: (params: P) => void) => () => void` | Follow the launch parameters. |
| `setLocation` | method | `(state: LocationState) => void` | Tell the host where inside this extension the user now is. |
| `host` | field | `Host` | igni, as this extension sees it: the host object model (`docs/HOST_OBJECT_MODEL.md` in igni). The same model the extension's process reaches as `ext.host`. |
| `on` | method | `(signal: Signal<T>, fn: (value: T) => void, onRefused?: (error: HostError) => void,) => () => void` | Handle a host signal: `bridge.on(bridge.host.chat.run_completed, fn)`. |
| `service` | field | `ServiceBridge` | The extension's own service, reached directly, as the signed-in person: |

### Bridge.rpc()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | `string` | required | the method to call, as `ext.<extension-id>.<method>` names it. |
| `args` | `RpcArgs` | optional | the method's arguments, by name. |
| `timeoutMs` | `number` | optional | how long to wait for the answer before giving up, in milliseconds. The host has a timeout of its own, and the shorter of the two is the one that fires. |

### Bridge.navigate()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to` | `string` | required | the page to go to; the host decides whether it exists. |

### Bridge.onTheme()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fn` | `(theme: string) => void` | required | called with the theme whenever it changes. |

### Bridge.onParams()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fn` | `(params: P) => void` | required | called with the parameters whenever they change. |

### Bridge.setLocation()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `LocationState` | required | where inside the extension the user is now, in strings, for the host to fold into its own URL. |

### Bridge.on()

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `signal` | `Signal<T>` | required | the host signal to follow. |
| `fn` | `(value: T) => void` | required | called with the signal's value each time it arrives. |
| `onRefused` | `(error: HostError) => void` | optional | called with the refusal when the host will not grant the signal; without one the refusal goes to the console. |
